notes:
Here are three places in Oakville with preschool swim lessons this fall. For all three I'm working from each operator's own site. None of the pages I read showed a day, time or price for a preschool class.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Preschool Levels A - E swim lessons, Town of Oakville (Learn to Swim)",
      "age_fit": "Preschool Levels A - E; children must be the age required for the level by the program start date",
      "source_name": "Town of Oakville"
    },
    {
      "name": "YMCA Preschool Swim Lessons, YMCA of Oakville",
      "age_fit": "3-5 years",
      "when": "12-week sessions with a one-week break between sessions; one class per week for the Parent and Tot program",
      "source_name": "YMCA of Oakville"
    },
    {
      "name": "Preschool swim lessons, Goldfish Swim School Oakville",
      "age_fit": "Enrollment begins at four months; programs for children 4 months to 12 years",
      "source_name": "Goldfish Swim School"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **Town of Oakville:** The Town's rates and fees list shows Preschool Levels A - E. Its site says 
online registration for Fall programs is now open
, and 
winter registration opens Tuesday, December 1 at 7 a.m.
 Non-residents can register 
14 days after Oakville resident registration begins
. I could not read the preschool class days, times or fees. The class listings sit on the Town's registration site.
- **YMCA of Oakville:** Its swim lessons page says 
3-5 years
 for the preschool program. It also says 
swim lessons run in 12-week sessions with a one-week program break
. I could not find a day, time, price or registration date for the preschool class.
- **Goldfish Swim School:** Its Oakville page says 
enrollment begins at four months
 and mentions preschool swim lessons. I could not find a preschool class day, time or price. The school's registration portal is where to look.
